basis: Catalogue action/side constraints informed by ml/sports/recognition_taxonomy_sources.json; measured close groups are clustered inside each broad family. Names remain engineering proposals pending coach review.

static.ready_stances.name: Ready and standing positions
static.ready_stances.description: Ready, neutral and court-position stances; tactical intent is not inferred from body pose.

static.hitting_positions.name: Hitting positions
static.hitting_positions.description: Stroke and contact preparations with no side asserted by the source label.

static.lunge_reach_positions.name: Lunge and reach positions
static.lunge_reach_positions.description: Low or extended reaching bases, including side-specific catalogue variants.

static.balance_holds.name: Balance holds
static.balance_holds.description: Single-leg balance holds; currently no usable recording.

dynamic.forehand_strokes.name: Forehand strokes
dynamic.forehand_strokes.description: Catalogue-labelled forehand swings; precise shot trajectory requires racket and ball evidence.

dynamic.backhand_strokes.name: Backhand strokes
dynamic.backhand_strokes.description: Catalogue-labelled backhand swings; precise shot trajectory requires racket and ball evidence.

dynamic.unspecified_strokes.name: Strokes with unspecified side
dynamic.unspecified_strokes.description: Generic stroke labels do not imply forehand or backhand.

dynamic.stroke_recovery.name: Stroke and recovery sequences
dynamic.stroke_recovery.description: A labelled stroke followed by recovery, without inferring tactical success.

dynamic.lunges_reaches.name: Lunges and reaches
dynamic.lunges_reaches.description: Lunges and reaching motions, independent of attacking or defensive intent.

dynamic.recovery.name: Recovery steps and return movements
dynamic.recovery.description: Recovery footwork; return-to-T labels depend on known court context.

dynamic.forward_travel.name: Forward travel
dynamic.forward_travel.description: Source-labelled forward or front-court travel; direction is relative to the documented capture context.

dynamic.backward_travel.name: Backward travel
dynamic.backward_travel.description: Source-labelled backward or back-court travel; direction is relative to the documented capture context.

dynamic.direction_changes.name: Footwork preparation and direction changes
dynamic.direction_changes.description: Split steps, pivots, starts, stops and changes of travel direction.

dynamic.court_travel.name: Court travel and transitions
dynamic.court_travel.description: Court travel with unspecified direction or a transition into a hitting position.
